# Security Policy

Galactic Stays is an educational hotel booking application built with SAP CAP and SAP Fiori Elements. The local demo uses an in-memory SQLite database, demo accounts, and simulated payments.

Security issues may still affect the project, including:

- vulnerabilities in application code or dependencies;
- authorization flaws that allow access to another user's data or restricted actions;
- exposure of sensitive information through API responses or logs.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions, or pull requests.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/vontanne/galactic-stays/security/advisories/new

Security reports are handled privately through GitHub.

For non-security issues such as UI problems, documentation errors, or feature requests, please use the regular [issue templates](https://github.com/vontanne/galactic-stays/issues/new/choose).
